title: 6.24.3 Lab: Jump, slide and wait
description: The letters on the board come alive: J jumps ahead 3, S slides back 3, and W makes a player miss a turn.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: This is your race from 6.23.3. The coloured squares do nothing yet, and they show no letter.

steps.title: Show the letters
steps.instructions: In `drawBoard()`, after each square's `rect`, write its letter on it when it is not a plain `.`: `if (s.kind !== '.') text(s.kind, s.x - 5, s.y + 6, 16, 'white');`.

steps.title: Jump and slide
steps.instructions: In `takeTurn`, after the move, read `const kind = path[p.at].kind;`. On a `'J'`, `p.at = min(p.at + 3, last)`; on an `'S'`, `p.at = max(p.at - 3, 0)`. Add to the message so the players can see what happened: `message += ', jumped ahead 3';`.
hints: Check the win AFTER the letters: a J near the end can carry a token onto the last square.
If you brought your 6.23.3 work forward, your player variable may not be called `p`; use yours.

steps.title: Wait a turn
steps.instructions: Give every player `waiting: false` in `newGame()`. On a `'W'`, set `p.waiting = true`. In `nextTurn()`, after the turn passes, if `players[turn].waiting` is true, set it back to false and pass the turn once more.
hints: Forget to clear the flag and that player never plays again.
Play until someone lands on square 12 or 24, and watch the other player roll twice in a row.

requirements.title: J jumps ahead 3
requirements.description: Landing on a J moves the player 3 squares on. Help: 6.24.1 (Reading: The square decides)

requirements.title: S slides back 3
requirements.description: Landing on an S moves the player 3 squares back, never below 0. Help: 6.24.1 (Reading: The square decides)

requirements.title: W sets a flag
requirements.description: Landing on a W marks the player as waiting. Help: 6.24.1 (Reading: The square decides)

requirements.title: A waiting player is skipped once
requirements.description: When the turn passes to a waiting player, the flag is cleared and the turn passes again. Help: 6.24.1 (Reading: The square decides)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Jump, slide and wait". The task: after each move, read the letter of the square the player landed on: J moves them 3 ahead (not past the end), S moves them 3 back (not below 0), and W sets a waiting flag; when the turn passes to a waiting player, clear the flag and pass the turn again. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.title: W flags
rubric.description: W marks the player as waiting.

rubric.title: The wait is used up
rubric.description: A waiting player is skipped once and the flag is cleared.
